description: Find or add a company by website domain and queue background research into its ads, landing pages, store details, and technologies. Newly tracked companies consume one monthly research allowance when research is dispatched. Already tracked companies do not consume another allowance. Results populate asynchronously. Returns data only: nothing is shown to the user yet. Once you know the answer, call sightglass_show once with this call's resultId to show it as cards; the show call does not search again.

domain.description: The brand's website domain, e.g. gruns.co

projectId.description: Replo project id, from list_projects: where the charge or the asset lands. Its workspace's plan applies.

workspaceId.description: Replo workspace id, from list_workspaces. Sets which workspace's plan applies; required when the user has more than one workspace.

name: sightglass_research_company
title: Research a new brand
